name: Misasagi Akane
source: Ria's classmate [spoiler]and she is a daughter of Misasagi Financial Group President. Sometimes, Akane gets a little jealous when seeing Ria having fun while working in student council[/spoiler]. She is the president of the wagashi club and also often argues with Nanaka. Akane can make Nanaka lose very easy with her speaking.
